# commander_classic_server (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a **classic Server** record by **UID**.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a classic serverCredentials record by UID.
data "commander_classic_server" "example" {
  server = "_REPLACE_WITH_RECORD_UID_"
}

output "server_id" {
  value = data.commander_classic_server.example.id
}

output "server_title" {
  value = data.commander_classic_server.example.title
}

output "server_login" {
  value = data.commander_classic_server.example.login
}

output "server_hostname" {
  value = data.commander_classic_server.example.hostname
}

output "server_port" {
  value = data.commander_classic_server.example.port
}

output "server_password" {
  value     = data.commander_classic_server.example.password
  sensitive = true
}

output "server_custom" {
  value     = data.commander_classic_server.example.custom
  sensitive = true
}

output "server_share" {
  value = data.commander_classic_server.example.share
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server` (String) Server credentials record **UID** to look up.

### Read-Only

- `custom` (Attributes List) Custom fields stored in the record's `custom` array. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom))
- `folder_location` (String) Folder `path` or `UID` where the record is to be stored.
- `hostname` (String) **Hostname** or **IP address**.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier (UID) of the vault record.
- `login` (String) **Username** or **login** identifier.
- `notes` (String) Note of the record.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) **Password**.
- `port` (String) **Port** (numeric string).
- `share` (Attributes Map) Mapping of share permissions for this record. Each map **key** is a **user email**; each **value** is an object with `can_share` and `can_edit` booleans. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--share))
- `title` (String) Record title.

<a id="nestedatt--custom"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom`

Read-Only:

- `label` (String) Field label.
- `sensitive` (Boolean) Whether the value should be treated as **sensitive**.
- `type` (String) Keeper field **type** (e.g. `text`, `email`, `secret`).
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Field **value** (JSON-encoded for complex types).


<a id="nestedatt--share"></a>
### Nested Schema for `share`

Read-Only:

- `can_edit` (Boolean) Allow the user to edit this record. Defaults to `false`.
- `can_share` (Boolean) Allow the user to re-share this record with other users. Defaults to `false`.
